goal: extract visual grammar from sampled image/video evidence and configure existing World Server graphics systems without copying a reference pixel-for-pixel
rules: pixel statistics may describe style but may not invent semantic object identity
semantic hints must be preserved as attributed hints, not treated as measured pixels
large silhouette and composition mismatches are fixed before microdetail
video references require temporal evidence from more than one sampled frame
existing user-approved Golden graphics must be configured or reused, never silently replaced
no visual SUCCESS or FAILURE is recorded without the user's explicit decision
